claim: Adobe Analytics' figure, published on Saturday 28 November 2026, puts US online spending on Black Friday (27 November 2026) above $12.9bn, the figure Adobe forecast.

runs.scenario: If Adobe has not published a full-day figure by 23:00 ET on 28 November, one reader would resolve the claim as Pending under the criterion, while another would resolve it as NO under the event-window rule.
runs.yes_requires: Adobe Analytics publishes its first full-day figure for US online spending on Black Friday, 27 November 2026, within the event window, and the figure as stated is strictly greater than US$12.9 billion.
runs.decided_by: Adobe Analytics' first published full-day Black Friday 2026 figure, identified as us-blackfriday-29, using the amount as stated rather than rounding it to one decimal place.

runs.yes_requires: Adobe Analytics must publish a first full-day US online spending figure for Black Friday (27 November 2026) that is strictly greater than $12.9 billion by 23:00 ET on 28 November 2026.
runs.decided_by: Adobe Analytics' first published full-day Black Friday 2026 figure (referenced via claim us-blackfriday-29).

runs.scenario: If Adobe has published no full-day figure by 23:00 ET on 28 Nov 2026 (only a partial update, or the full-day total only later), the criterion says Pending while the event-window rule says NO, so one careful reader would leave it unresolved and another would resolve NO.
runs.yes_requires: Adobe's first full-day Black Friday 2026 US online-spending figure (claim us-blackfriday-29), taken as stated, is strictly above 12.9 billion USD and is published by 23:00 ET on 28 November 2026.
runs.decided_by: Adobe Analytics' stated first full-day Black Friday 2026 figure, compared with the criterion's 12.9 threshold.
